verdict.rationale: First-party docs state directly that you don't have to build the whole page in React: you can add it to an existing HTML page or stack and render interactive components anywhere on it (react-docs-1, react-docs-12, react-docs-31). createRoot mounts components into any browser DOM node (react-docs-8), and a page using 'sprinkles' of React can have as many separate roots as needed, with identifierPrefix to avoid ID conflicts between them (react-docs-29, react-docs-28). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of embedding React in a non-React server-rendered page, and no evidence on the setup needed for that path (JSX/build tooling).
